business.name: Sunrise Auto Detailers
business.service_model: Mobile only, with no shop address.

facts.statement: At Sunrise Auto Detailers, a "wash" or "just the outside" means the exterior wash (The Skiff), "just the inside" or an "interior clean" means the interior detail (The Cutter), "inside and out" means the full detail (The Schooner), and a "polish and seal" means The Flagship.

before_site.how: Cards label the first three packages exterior wash, interior detail and full detail, but the everyday phrases people say are never listed and "polish and seal" never appears. The owner doesn't think of it.

facts.statement: At Sunrise Auto Detailers, a "van" with no other detail means a full-size van such as a Ford Transit or Mercedes Sprinter, which is the oversized class, while a minivan or a compact van such as a Ford Transit Connect is the large class.

before_site.how: The board image lists full-size and compact vans in different classes, but nothing says what a plain "van" means. It hasn't occurred to the owner.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' exterior wash, sold as The Skiff, is a foam hand wash with wheels and tires, door jambs, outside glass and a hand dry, and it doesn't touch the inside of the vehicle.

Sunrise Auto Detailers' interior detail, sold as The Cutter, covers vacuuming the seats, carpets, mats and trunk, wiping down the dash, console and door panels, inside glass and spot-cleaning, and it doesn't include shampoo, pet hair removal or any exterior work.

includes: vacuum seats, carpets, mats and trunk
wipe dash, console and door panels

before_site.how: Contents are on the / package card, but the exclusions (shampoo, pet hair removal, exterior) are only in FAQ accordion 'Does the Cutter include shampoo?'.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' full detail, sold as The Schooner, is everything in the exterior wash and the interior detail plus a spray wax.

Sunrise Auto Detailers' top package, sold as The Flagship, is everything in the full detail plus a clay bar treatment, a one-step machine polish, a 6-month paint sealant and an upholstery and carpet shampoo, while pet hair removal and odour treatment still cost extra.

Whether The Flagship's one-step polish at Sunrise Auto Detailers will remove a particular scratch isn't known until a technician inspects it, because the answer depends on whether the scratch has gone through the clear coat.

value.unknown: whether a given scratch comes out
value.settled_by: a technician inspecting the scratch on site

before_site.how: It can't be known without seeing the vehicle, so the owner doesn't address it.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' small class, shown as Class A on its site, covers coupes, hatchbacks and compact cars such as a Honda Civic, Toyota Corolla, Mini Cooper or Mazda3.

before_site.how: Only in the key at the bottom of the price-board image on /. The text on the site uses the Class letters at most.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' midsize class, shown as Class B on its site, covers sedans, crossovers and two-row SUVs such as a Toyota Camry, Tesla Model 3, Tesla Model Y, Honda CR-V or Subaru Outback.

before_site.how: Only in the key at the bottom of the price-board image on /. The text on the site uses the Class letters at most.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' large class, shown as Class C on its site, covers three-row SUVs, minivans, compact vans and standard pickups such as a Toyota Highlander, Chevrolet Tahoe, Honda Odyssey, Ford Transit Connect, Toyota Tacoma, Ford F-150 or Ram 1500.

before_site.how: Only in the key at the bottom of the price-board image on /. The text on the site uses the Class letters at most.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' oversized class, shown as Class D on its site, covers full-size cargo and passenger vans, extended-length SUVs and heavy-duty pickups such as a Ford Transit, Mercedes Sprinter, Ram ProMaster, Chevrolet Express, Chevrolet Suburban, Ford F-250 or Ram 2500.

before_site.how: Only in the key at the bottom of the price-board image on /. The text on the site uses the Class letters at most.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' exterior wash (The Skiff) costs $69 for a small vehicle, $79 for a midsize vehicle, $99 for a large vehicle and $139 for an oversized vehicle, before any add-ons, fees and tax.

before_site.how: Per-size prices only in the price-board image on /. The text there gives only "starting at $69".

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' interior detail (The Cutter) costs $159 for a small vehicle, $179 for a midsize vehicle, $219 for a large vehicle and $289 for an oversized vehicle, before any add-ons, fees and tax.

before_site.how: Per-size prices only in the price-board image on /. The text there gives only "starting at $159".

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' full detail (The Schooner) costs $219 for a small vehicle, $249 for a midsize vehicle, $299 for a large vehicle and $399 for an oversized vehicle, before any add-ons, fees and tax.

before_site.how: Per-size prices only in the price-board image on /. The text there gives only "starting at $219".

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' polish-and-seal detail (The Flagship) costs $549 for a small vehicle, $629 for a midsize vehicle, $759 for a large vehicle and $949 for an oversized vehicle, before any add-ons, fees and tax.

before_site.how: Per-size prices only in the price-board image on /. The text there gives only "starting at $549".

facts.statement: The "starting at" prices on Sunrise Auto Detailers' site are the small-class prices of $69 for the exterior wash, $159 for the interior detail, $219 for the full detail and $549 for The Flagship, and any larger vehicle costs more.

A Sunrise Auto Detailers total is the service price for the vehicle's size class plus add-ons, condition surcharges, any generator fee, any Saturday, after-hours or same-day fee, the travel fee and sales tax, and every part is a fixed amount except odour treatment, which is a range.

before_site.how: The site says "starting at" and, in the FAQ, that add-ons and some fees are on top. The owner prices each job as it comes and has never written out the formula.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' owner hasn't decided whether prices will change for jobs from 1 January 2027, and that will be settled when she finishes the 2027 price sheet.

value.settled_by: the owner finishing the 2027 price sheet

before_site.how: She hasn't decided yet, so there's nothing to publish.

before_site.how: Named on /. Prices only in the price-board image on /. The package requirement is only in FAQ accordion 'I have a dog. Can you get the hair out?'. The 30 minutes isn't published.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' upholstery and carpet shampoo add-on costs $65 for a small vehicle, $75 for a midsize vehicle, $95 for a large vehicle and $125 for an oversized vehicle, adds about 60 minutes, can only be added to the interior detail or full detail, and is already included in The Flagship.

before_site.how: Named on /. Prices only in the price-board image on /. The package requirement is only in FAQ accordion 'Does the Cutter include shampoo?'. The 60 minutes isn't published.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' odour treatment add-on (smoke smell, mildew smell, musty car) costs $90 for a 1-hour ozone treatment or $140 for a 2-hour ozone treatment, which the technician chooses after a smell test on arrival, and it can only be added to the interior detail, full detail or The Flagship.

before_site.how: Named on /. The two prices are only in the price-board image on /. The smell test, ozone and package requirement are only in FAQ accordion 'Can you get rid of a smoke smell?'.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' clay bar add-on, which lifts bonded grit off the paint, costs $60 for a small vehicle, $70 for a midsize vehicle, $85 for a large vehicle and $110 for an oversized vehicle, adds about 45 minutes, can only be added to the exterior wash or full detail, and is already included in The Flagship.

before_site.how: Named on /. Prices only in the price-board image on /. The package requirement is only in FAQ accordion 'How long does the wax last?'. The 45 minutes isn't published.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' 6-month paint sealant add-on (wax, paint protection) costs $95 for a small vehicle, $115 for a midsize vehicle, $135 for a large vehicle and $175 for an oversized vehicle, adds about 45 minutes, can only be bought together with the clay bar add-on on an exterior wash or full detail, and is already included in The Flagship.

before_site.how: Named on /. Prices only in the price-board image on /. The clay bar requirement is only in FAQ accordion 'How long does the wax last?'. The 45 minutes isn't published.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' headlight restoration (foggy or yellowed headlights) costs $85 per pair at any vehicle size, takes about 45 minutes, can be booked on its own with no other service, and carries the usual travel fee but no deposit.

before_site.how: Named on /. The price is only in the price-board image on /. Booking it alone, the time, no deposit and the travel fee are only in FAQ accordion 'My headlights are foggy, can you help?'.

facts.statement: At Sunrise Auto Detailers, pet hair counts as excessive when it's embedded in the fabric of 3 or more seating positions or across more than half of the cargo or trunk floor, which adds a $60 surcharge on top of the required pet hair removal add-on.

before_site.how: / and the FAQ say only "excessive pet hair ... may cost extra". The owner keeps the definition and amount internal so technicians can use judgement.

facts.statement: At Sunrise Auto Detailers, an interior counts as heavily soiled when mud or sand covers more than half of the floor area, dried spills mark 2 or more seats, or loose trash fills more than one 13-gallon bag, which adds a $75 surcharge.

before_site.how: / and the FAQ say only "heavily soiled vehicles may cost extra". The owner doesn't publish the definition or amount.

facts.statement: At Sunrise Auto Detailers, an exterior counts as heavily contaminated when tree sap, road tar or etched bird droppings are on 3 or more body panels, which adds a $50 surcharge to any service that includes the exterior.

before_site.how: The owner treats this as something to explain on arrival, so the site doesn't mention it.

facts.statement: A Sunrise Auto Detailers technician checks the size class and any surcharge condition before starting, shows the customer photos and the new price if anything differs from the booking, and a customer who declines doesn't get the job done and doesn't get the deposit back.

before_site.how: FAQ accordion 'How much does it cost?' says only that the final price is confirmed on seeing the vehicle. Photos, the new price and losing the deposit if you decline are left to the conversation on the day.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers serves passenger cars, SUVs, pickups, minivans and cargo or passenger vans up to 24 feet long, 10 feet tall and a 14,000 lb gross weight rating, including electric vehicles and soft-top convertibles, and it will wash the outside of a camper van conversion at the oversized price.

before_site.how: FAQ accordion 'What do you work on?' lists vehicle types, electric and soft-tops only. The length, height and weight limits and camper van pricing aren't published, because few customers need them.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers doesn't clay, polish or seal matte paint, satin paint or vinyl wraps, so The Flagship and the clay bar and paint sealant add-ons aren't available on those vehicles, while the exterior wash, interior detail and full detail are.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'Can you do matte paint or a wrap?'.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' owner hasn't decided whether to clean the living quarters of camper van conversions, and that will be settled once she has tried one and worked out the time it takes.

value.unknown: whether camper van living quarters are cleaned
value.settled_by: the owner trying one and timing it

before_site.how: She hasn't decided, so the site says nothing.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' owner hasn't decided which size class a Tesla Cybertruck belongs in or whether its stainless steel panels can be polished, and that will be settled once she has inspected one.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers brings its own water in a 65-gallon tank, so a customer doesn't need to provide water for up to 2 vehicles, but a job of 3 or more vehicles needs a working spigot within 100 feet.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'Do I need to give you water or power?'.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' interior detail, full detail and The Flagship need a grounded 120-volt outlet within 75 feet of the vehicle, or a $30 generator fee, and because the generator can't run in an enclosed or underground garage those services can't be done there without an outlet, while the exterior wash needs no power.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'Do I need to give you water or power?'.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers needs the vehicle in a driveway, private lot, open garage or street space that stays legal for the whole job, with at least 3 feet clear on both sides, plus somewhere within 100 feet for its work van, which is 20 feet long and 7 feet 2 inches tall.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'Where will you park?'. The van's length and height aren't published.

facts.statement: A Sunrise Auto Detailers customer parked at an apartment building, condo or HOA-managed lot must get the building manager's permission for the work before booking, because Sunrise doesn't contact managers and a refusal on the day counts as a no-show.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'I live in an apartment or condo, is that OK?'.

facts.statement: A Sunrise Auto Detailers customer must remove personal belongings, child seats and cargo before arrival, and an adult must hand over the keys at the start and stay reachable until the end, because areas still full of belongings aren't cleaned and the price doesn't drop.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'What should I do before you get here?'.
The map image on / shows region names only, with no ZIP list. A small owner draws a map and doesn't publish ZIP codes.

before_site.how: The map image on / shows region names only, with no ZIP list and no fee amount. A small owner draws a map and doesn't publish ZIP codes.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers serves these Marin and East Bay ZIP codes for a $65 travel fee per visit, which includes the bridge toll: 94607, 94608, 94609, 94610, 94611, 94612, 94618, 94704, 94705, 94920, 94941, 94965.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers works Tuesday to Saturday and is closed Sunday and Monday, with a morning arrival window of 8:00 am to 9:30 am and an afternoon arrival window of 1:00 pm to 2:30 pm on Tuesday to Friday, and only the morning window on Saturday.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'What time will you get here?', and in the /book calendar after the lead form.

facts.statement: A Sunrise Auto Detailers job takes about 1 to 1.5 hours for the exterior wash, 2 to 4 hours for the interior detail, 3 to 5 hours for the full detail and 6 to 8 hours for The Flagship depending on size, and any job of 5 hours or more including add-ons must start in the morning window.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'How long does it take?'.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers needs at least 24 hours' notice before the start of an arrival window, apart from its same-day phone rule.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'Can you come today?'.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers takes same-day work only by phone before 10:00 am, only for the exterior wash or interior detail, only in that day's afternoon window and only if a technician is free, and it adds a $40 same-day fee.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'Can you come today?'.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' current open arrival windows are shown on its booking calendar, where a window is open when at least one of its technicians is free.

before_site.how: The calendar appears only after the step 1 form on /book asks for name, email, phone and address. What an open window means isn't explained.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers has 2 technicians, owner Ines Calloway and Theo Brandt, and Ines does every Flagship herself on Wednesday, Thursday and Friday mornings only, while either technician does all other work at the same price and customers can't choose which one comes.

before_site.how: / says only that Ines Calloway and Theo do the work. The owner's Flagship days and the no-choice rule aren't published; she sorts that out in her reply.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers takes a $50 deposit to book any job, or $150 for The Flagship, with no deposit on a headlight-only visit, and the deposit counts toward the total.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'Do you take a deposit?'.

facts.statement: A Sunrise Auto Detailers customer who cancels at least 48 hours before the start of the arrival window gets the full deposit back, between 24 and 48 hours gets half back, and under 24 hours gets nothing back.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'What if I need to cancel or change the date?'.

facts.statement: A Sunrise Auto Detailers customer can reschedule once for free with at least 24 hours' notice, by phone or text only, and any later or shorter-notice change counts as a cancellation.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'What if I need to cancel or change the date?'.

facts.statement: A Sunrise Auto Detailers technician waits 20 minutes at the appointment, and if the vehicle, the keys or access still aren't available the visit counts as a no-show and the whole deposit is kept.

before_site.how: The FAQ says only that you could lose your deposit if the car can't be reached, and uses "no-show" undefined. The 20-minute wait isn't published.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers moves exterior work when the National Weather Service forecast shows a 50% or higher chance of rain for the job's ZIP code, tells the customer by 7:00 pm the evening before, and offers a free new date or a full deposit refund, while interior-only jobs go ahead.

before_site.how: FAQ accordion 'What if it rains?' says rain moves exterior work, with word the evening before, and the deposit is safe. The forecast source, the threshold, the 7:00 pm deadline and the remedy options aren't published.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers comes back and redoes a missed area for free if the customer sends a photo within 48 hours of the job, with no cash refunds, and this doesn't cover stains or scratches that were already there.

before_site.how: / gives the photo within 48 hours and the free redo. No cash refunds and the existing stains and scratches exclusion are only in FAQ accordion 'What if I'm not happy with the job?'.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers takes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay and Google Pay, with the deposit paid by card link and the balance due when the job is finished, in cash if the customer prefers, and it doesn't take checks from non-fleet customers, doesn't offer financing or payment plans, and never adds a tip to the total.

before_site.how: Only in FAQ accordion 'How do I pay?'. Checks, financing and tips aren't addressed.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers adds 8.625% sales tax in every ZIP code to services, add-ons, surcharges, the generator fee and timing fees, but not to the travel fee or to gift card purchases.

before_site.how: The site never mentions tax. It first appears on the invoice, because the owner thinks of the board prices as the prices.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers adds a $25 Saturday fee to any job done on a Saturday.

before_site.how: Shown only beside Saturday dates on the booking calendar, /book step 2, after the lead form.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers offers an after-hours evening arrival window of 5:00 pm to 6:00 pm on Tuesdays and Thursdays, for the exterior wash only with no add-ons, only in its no-travel-fee San Francisco ZIP codes, for a $30 after-hours fee.

before_site.how: The /book calendar shows the Tuesday and Thursday evening window with only "after-hours fee applies". The amount, the Skiff-only and no-add-on rules and the zone limit aren't published; the owner sorts these out in her reply.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers is closed on 11 November 2026, 26 to 27 November 2026, 24 December 2026 to 1 January 2027, and 16 to 18 February 2027.

before_site.how: FAQ accordion 'Are you open on holidays?' says only that they close for some holidays and over the winter, and the calendar silently leaves those dates out. The owner hasn't written the dates on the site.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' recurring plan takes 15% off the service price for visits every 2 weeks or 10% off for visits every 4 weeks, on the exterior wash, interior detail or full detail for one vehicle at one address, with the first visit at full price, at least 3 visits, and no discount on add-ons or fees.

before_site.how: / says only "Ask about discounts". The owner quotes these when people call and hasn't written the terms up.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers treats 3 or more vehicles at one address on one day as a fleet job, taking 10% off the service price for 3 to 4 vehicles and 15% off for 5 to 10 vehicles, on the exterior wash, interior detail or full detail only, and discounts don't combine.

before_site.how: / says only "Ask about discounts". The owner quotes these when people call and hasn't written the terms up.

facts.statement: Sunrise Auto Detailers' fleet jobs run Tuesday to Friday only, pay one travel fee per visit however many vehicles are done, and can be invoiced at net 15 for accounts of 5 or more vehicles with a signed agreement.
